claim: three-dimensional five-link adaptation preserving Lv et al.'s suspension-point-acceleration swing-regulation mechanism

architecture.nominal_backbone: one frozen Traditional LQR gain, used without retuning
architecture.outer_tracking_adapter: causal cutter-tip position error is mapped to a bounded desired load velocity; Eq.31 velocity feedback becomes an acceleration correction
architecture.equivalent_swing: r_eq = p_tip - p_uav and v_eq = v_tip - v_uav; alpha=atan2(r_y,-r_z), beta=atan2(r_x,-r_z)
architecture.middle_loop: paper Eq.18 shaped swing errors on alpha and beta
architecture.decoupler: paper Eqs.25-27 reduced to the equivalent-pendulum suspension-acceleration bridge on world x/y
architecture.limiter: shared amplitude +/-2 m/s^2 then 0.25 m/s^2/update slew
